luiskr.com / components/nav/menu / closeNavMenu

function closeNavMenu(host): void

Defined in: website/components/nav/menu.tsx:206

Closes the menu through the full dissolve cycle: adds the -closing class (CSS plays the item fade-out), releases the contour field so it dissolves back to center, then after MENU_CLOSE_DURATION destroys all three GL widgets + their canvases and re-renders the closed nav. The _menuClosing guard makes double-close (Esc + click) a no-op.

host

NavMenuHost
